description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for different models and training configurations. The horizontal axis displays the category labels: “RoBERTa w/o Exp.”, “LaSQuE (mean)”, “LaSQuE”, “LaSQuE (syn2real)”, and “LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick marks at 5% intervals. Four bars are present for each category, distinguished by color: light gray for “RoBERTa w/o Exp.”, light blue for “LaSQuE (mean)”, orange for “LaSQuE”, green for “LaSQuE (syn2real)”, and dark gray for “LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum”. The “RoBERTa w/o Exp.” bar reaches approximately 52%, while the “LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum” bar extends to approximately 64%. The bars are grouped by category, with each group representing the accuracy score for a specific model or configuration. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
